text:
Maya: Quick shoutout thread — huge thanks to @Samir, @Jules, and the infra crew for pulling the DB migration over the weekend with zero user impact. Drop any kudos here and your treat preference (bagels / tacos / donuts) and People Ops will sort treats.

Samir: Really appreciate everyone. Special shout to Riley for staying late and handling the traffic reroute :raised_hands:

Jules: Big ups to QA too — staging smoke tests were spotless. @Priya you were incredible with flaky test triage.

Riley: Happy to help! Bagels pls 🥯 Also massive props to Eng-Infra for the canary rollout work.

Priya: Glad it helped — donuts > bagels imo :doughnut:

Ethan: Noted. Quick logistics: react to this thread with an emoji for the food poll — :bagel: for bagels, :taco: for tacos, :doughnut: for donuts. I'll order based on the majority and get it to the kitchen tomorrow at 9:30am. Also compiling names for a small e-card.

Maya: If anyone else had triage/shift swaps or demo saves that weekend, drop names so we can include them in the e-card to leadership.

Samir: Shoutout to Nia for the canary scripts that reduced rollback time.

Nia: thank u!! :blush:

Jules: :thumbsup:

Ethan: Poll results: bagels won narrowly. Ordering for 10, delivering 9:30am. Sending the e-card + Slack kudos thread to the exec summary now. Thanks everyone — love the cross-team hustle.
